name: Student Visa

requirements.blocker_text: Admission and acceptance from an Oman-based higher education institution, which acts as sponsor and manages the visa application on the student's behalf.
requirements.fix_path: Secure admission to an accredited Omani institution.

requirements.blocker_text: Medical testing on arrival is required before a residence card is issued.

evidence_required.document: Admission/enrollment letter from an Omani institution

sources.title: Commoner Law -- Oman student visa guide: institution-sponsored, 1-year renewable visa, work restricted to university-approved internships/research, no automatic post-study work visa, medical test required on arrival

notes: NEW COUNTRY BUILD (Oman). STATUS: DRAFT -- no tier-1 government page (Royal Oman Police or Ministry of Higher Education) with equivalent process detail was independently fetched in this pass; sourced entirely to a specialist immigration-law firm's guide. work_rights modeled 'restricted' since work is limited to university-approved internships/research, not general employment. Explicitly no automatic post-graduation work visa exists -- graduates must independently secure an employer sponsor, and Omanisation quotas (see om_work_permit.json) can make this difficult, disclosed here rather than assumed.
